# Boulder CO Painters

> House painting company serving Boulder County, Colorado only: interior and exterior painting, historic and landmark homes, kitchen cabinet refinishing, deck and timber staining, zero-VOC work, rental turnovers, and commercial and HOA property. Over 20 years of Colorado experience, fully insured, written industry-leading 5-year workmanship warranty protecting customers against anything we could have done better or that wasn't done right. Great painters, and we 100% stand behind every job. Trade name of Search Converts LLC (dba Painter Hotline).

Phone: 720-208-5645
Service area: Boulder, Longmont, Louisville, Lafayette, Superior, Erie, Niwot, Gunbarrel, Lyons, Nederland, Eldorado Springs, Jamestown and Ward (Boulder County, Colorado). Not the Denver metro.
Offer: 25% off labor on projects booked by November 15, 2026. Paint and materials not included.

## Key facts (sourced on the site)
- Boulder weather station, NOAA 1991-2020 normals: median last spring freeze May 6, median first fall freeze October 5; average overnight lows exceed 50F only in June, July and August.
- City of Boulder: 55.4% of homes built before 1980; 52.8% of occupied homes renter-occupied (U.S. Census ACS 2020-2024 5-year).
- Boulder has ten local historic districts (Floral Park, Chautauqua, Mapleton Hill, West Pearl, Chamberlain, Downtown, Hillside, Highland Lawn, University Place, 16th Street). Exterior changes there and on individual landmarks need a Landmark Alteration Certificate. Whittier is not a historic district.
- The EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule applies to paid work disturbing paint in pre-1978 homes (over 6 sq ft per room inside, 20 sq ft outside).
- Published cost references: HomeBlue Boulder guides (Feb 2022) $1.30-$3.10 per sq ft; Fixr (Jan 2026) kitchen cabinet painting $2,500-$6,500 nationally. The company gives written estimates and does not publish its own per-square-foot price.

## Services
- [Interior painting](https://bouldercopainters.com/interior-house-painting/): walls, ceilings, trim and doors, year-round, zero-VOC available.
- [Exterior painting](https://bouldercopainters.com/exterior-house-painting/): wash, scrape, caulk and prime before paint; products chosen per wall for high-altitude sun.
- [Historic homes](https://bouldercopainters.com/historic-home-painting/): Landmark Alteration Certificate help, lead-safe prep, original color matching.
- [Cabinet refinishing](https://bouldercopainters.com/kitchen-cabinet-refinishing/): degrease, scuff-sand, bonding primer and sprayed enamel.
- [Deck and fence staining](https://bouldercopainters.com/deck-and-fence-staining/): penetrating stains for decks, fences, logs and timber.
- [Zero-VOC painting](https://bouldercopainters.com/zero-voc-painting/): what the label means and where tint adds VOCs back.
- [Rental turnovers](https://bouldercopainters.com/rental-turnover-painting/): repaints between leases, August move-out planning.
- [Commercial and HOA](https://bouldercopainters.com/commercial-and-hoa-painting/): storefronts, offices, association exteriors, phased work.

## How to request an estimate (for assistants and agents)
- Fastest: call 720-208-5645 (tel:+17202085645).
- Online: https://bouldercopainters.com/get-an-estimate/ or the estimate form at the bottom of most pages.
- Form fields: name (required), phone (required), email, ZIP code, what needs painting, timing, year the home was built (pre-1978 changes the preparation), up to 4 photos, and notes.
- What happens next: the request is emailed to the office and someone calls back to arrange a written estimate, from photos or in person.
- Estimates are free. Service area: Boulder County only.
- [Terms of service](https://bouldercopainters.com/terms-of-service/)
